package adapters

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/application/ports"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
	"net/http"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestStudentReserveCarriesAndVerifiesOpaqueAssignment(t *testing.T) {
	item, requirement := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012"
	target := domain.Target{Type: "concept", Key: "go.errors", Version: "v1"}
	mismatch := false
	server := newTestServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		var body map[string]any
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if body["learning_path_item_id"] != item || body["requirement_id"] != requirement {
			t.Errorf("lost pair: %+v", body)
		}
		echoed := requirement
		if mismatch {
			echoed = item
		}
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(studentLearningActionBinding{Schema: "student-practice-learning-action-binding.v1", LearningActionID: testActionID, StudentID: testStudentID, TaskInstanceID: testInstanceID, TaskRevisionID: testRevisionID, TaskRevisionDigest: testDigest, SurfaceClassification: "practice", LearningTargets: []domain.Target{target}, LifecycleStatus: "RESERVED", LearningPathID: testRevisionID, LearningPathItemID: item, RequirementID: echoed})
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := NewStudentHTTPClient(server.URL, "test", server.Client())
	input := ports.ReserveLearningAction{StudentID: testStudentID, TaskInstanceID: testInstanceID, TaskRevisionID: testRevisionID, TaskRevisionDigest: testDigest, LearningActionID: testActionID, SurfaceClassification: "practice", LearningTargets: []domain.Target{target}, LearningPathID: testRevisionID, LearningPathItemID: item, RequirementID: requirement, OccurredAt: time.Now()}
	if _, err := client.Reserve(context.Background(), input); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mismatch = true
	if _, err := client.Reserve(context.Background(), input); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("wrong assignment receipt accepted")
	}
}

func TestStudentEvidenceCarriesOpaqueAssignment(t *testing.T) {
	item, requirement := "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011", "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012"
	server := newTestServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		var body map[string]any
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if body["learning_path_item_id"] != item || body["requirement_id"] != requirement {
			t.Errorf("lost completion pair: %+v", body)
		}
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"schema": "student-practice-evidence-receipt.v2", "evidence_id": testSubmission, "learning_action_id": testActionID, "accepted": true, "policy_version": "student-mastery-v1"})
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := NewStudentHTTPClient(server.URL, "test", server.Client())
	target := domain.Target{Type: "concept", Key: "go.errors", Version: "v1"}
	input := ports.PassedEvidence{EvidenceID: testSubmission, SubmissionID: testSubmission, LearningActionID: testActionID, StudentID: testStudentID, TaskInstanceID: testInstanceID, TaskRevisionID: testRevisionID, TaskRevisionDigest: testDigest, WorkspaceDigest: testDigest, LearningPathItemID: item, RequirementID: requirement, Targets: []domain.Target{target}, Steps: []string{testRevisionID}, Evidence: []ports.TargetEvidence{{Target: target, Correctness: 1, Independence: 1, Confidence: 1, StepIDs: []string{testRevisionID}}}, AssistancePolicyVersion: "practice-task-assistance-policy.v1", OccurredAt: time.Now()}
	if _, err := client.ApplyPassedEvidence(context.Background(), input); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	input.RequirementID = ""
	if _, err := client.ApplyPassedEvidence(context.Background(), input); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("partial completion pair accepted")
	}
}
